owner_request: Practice-scope change before the 17 November 2026 exam: stop practising Cap. 34 as live questions. Retire the nine live items that specifically test Cap. 34, revise m1-151 so it no longer cites the 17 November 2025 circular or the Money Changers Ordinance, and remove documents 16 and 17 from the live question allowlist. Documents 16 and 17 remain in daily reading and the study notes. This is a personal practice-scope decision, not a claim that Cap. 34 will be absent from the official examination.
method_summary: Nine live questions that cited only document 17 (m1-190 to m1-197 and m4-419) were retired and their IDs reserved in bank/retired-ids.json. m1-151 was revised in place: the two Cap. 34 / circular statements were deleted; the four Guideline ¶1.14–1.15 chapter-number statements were kept; two further true chapter-number statements already used in this bank (DTROP is Cap. 405; UNATMO is Cap. 575) were added so the item again has three true statements and usable generated option groups; sources were reduced to Guideline ¶1.14–1.15. m2-341 was not changed. Documents 16 and 17 were removed from catalog.json.question_bank_scope but were not archived from daily reading, the study notes or the official PDFs. No new question IDs were added. The revised item was answered blind, statement by statement in both languages, from docs/text EN/TC 03.txt ¶1.14–1.15 without keys, explanations or quotes. All 6 first-round verdicts matched the key, with no doubts or language mismatches. Each recorded verdict is bound to the final stem, statements and citation by a text hash.

revisions.reason: Delete the two Cap. 34 / 17 November 2025 circular statements. Keep the four Guideline ¶1.14–1.15 chapter-number statements (OSCO/DTROP chapter numbers swapped; Cap. 537 named as UNATMO; JFIU named as AMLO supervisor; WMD(CPS)O Cap. 526). Rebuild options after only one of those four remained true by adding two further true chapter-number statements already used in this bank: DTROP is Cap. 405 and UNATMO is Cap. 575 among the main pieces listed in ¶1.14. The stem and sources now refer only to ordinances listed in the AML/CFT Guideline. Legal meaning of the kept defects is unchanged: DTROP is Cap. 405 and OSCO is Cap. 455; Cap. 537 is UNSO and UNATMO is Cap. 575; AMLO supervision is CCE not JFIU; WMD(CPS)O is Cap. 526.

blind_review.method: Independent-context bilingual blind review of the revised m1-151 against docs/text/EN/03.txt and docs/text/TC/03.txt ¶1.14–1.15, without keys, notes, patches or the live bank. No items were added. The nine retired identifiers are recorded in retired_ids and are reserved against reuse.

quotes: Guideline ¶1.14 lists DTROP as Cap. 405 and OSCO as Cap. 455. The statement swaps those chapter numbers. / 第1.14段列《販毒（追討得益）條例》為第405章、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》為第455章；陳述把兩者章號對調。
Guideline ¶1.14: Cap. 537 is the United Nations Sanctions Ordinance (UNSO); UNATMO is Cap. 575. / 第1.14段：第537章為《聯合國制裁條例》；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》為第575章。

Guideline ¶1.14: the Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance, Cap. 526 (WMD(CPS)O). / 第1.14段：《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》（第526章）。

Guideline ¶1.14 lists the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance, Cap. 405 (DTROP), among the main pieces of legislation concerned with ML, TF, PF and financial sanctions. / 第1.14段列《販毒（追討得益）條例》（第405章）為該等主要法例之一。
Guideline ¶1.14 lists the United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance, Cap. 575 (UNATMO), among those main pieces. / 第1.14段列《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》（第575章）為該等主要法例之一。
